_about: The face panels' crop records, written by hand (spec section 5b: the Faces check, L525; the crop records, L529; DECISIONS.md 14, 107 to 119). The panels are the expression sheet's and the master sheet's expression row (Happy, Excited, Laughing, Curious, Sleepy, Surprised, Winking, Cheeky, Content), which draws the same faces front-on at about 0.55 times the size. For each face preset of L480-498 its one primary panel, whose held anchors and shapes gate, and the panels shown beside it, measured the same way but never gating; for each panel, what it draws, its anchors placed by hand in its sheet's pixels (x right, y down) and checked on ref/overlays/faces-<panel>.png, the head's width, and the boxes of motion marks, labels and neighbours' slivers to leave out. characters/refprep/faces.py refines each anchor by its feature's rule, the rule the Faces check applies to a render, and fails when one is more than 2.5 crop px off its feature or out of order; model.py puts the records into model.json as faceCrops.
_primary: Each preset's primary panel draws its states front-on and level where a panel does: a level head (the least roll, the chin neither raised nor lowered), not turned, and among equals the master sheet's, which ranks above the expression sheet (L284). A face preset keeps the front's head (the Faces check holds the face to it), so a panel that raises the chin would hold a level face to a tilted one: Proud gives way to Content. Where no panel draws the preset's held states on a level head (curious, shy and sleepy: both Curious panels, the only Shy and both Sleepy panels turn the head 3.0 to 5.1 pt across), its own panel stays the primary and faces.py records it as turned (its eyes' middle further across from its nose than 3% of the head's width, beside where the turnaround's front puts it); there the check holds the eyes by their shapes and their spacing and holds their place on the render's own head (DECISIONS.md 110; kept by the founder over holding curious and shy to the master sheet's Happy, as proud is held to Content: docs/QUESTIONS.md Q27). The panels beside it are the other drawings of its states the spec names, shown for the eyes of the agent and the founder.
_anchors: Each anchor is placed by hand on its feature, then refined by its feature's rule (characters/refprep/faces.py), the rule the Faces check applies to a render. head.top: the highest point of the head's outline near it, on the tuft (reported, never held: the sheet draws the tuft differently in every panel, and Proud's raised chin brings it 11 pt nearer the nose). nose: the centroid of the nose's dark core grown back over its edge, the lines that join it to the mouth left out (measure.py's core). eye.R and eye.L, the dog's own right and left (the sheet's left and right in these front views): the centroid of the eye's dark mark, darker than L* 60 with the catchlight filled, an open eye's iris and rim or a closed, happy or winking eye's arc. mouth.R and mouth.L: the mouth's farthest reach each way across the head, at the tips of its upturned curls, or an open mouth's or an o's sides. Centroids and reaches weigh each pixel by its darkness, so they move smoothly with the drawing. The roll is the line from eye.R to eye.L, clockwise on the sheet.
_headWidth: The scale is model.json's headWidth (93.3 pt, the turnaround's cheeks between the ears' inner edges) over the panel's own head width, taken the same way along the head's across axis: the cheeks' widest run near the row placed here, each run from a quarter of the width out from the nose to the first line or tan (the cheek's outline over the ear; a patch); faces.py fails a row more than 2% short of the widest from the nose's row down 0.3 of the head. Measured so, the expression sheet's Happy has its eyes 46.1 pt apart and the master sheet's 47.7, the turnaround's 46.1. The master sheet's panels are measured enlarged twice (faces.py, SHEET_ZOOM: its heads are 72 to 78 px across the cheeks against the expression sheet's 127 to 137, and its mouths' lines 1 to 2 px wide); every number is kept in the crop's own pixels. Where a panel hides its cheeks (the expression sheet's Shy: the far ear hangs across the right cheek, so the run is 114 px against the others' 127 to 137; either sheet's Sleepy: the paws cover them) it takes the median width of its own sheet's expressions that show theirs, since each sheet draws its expressions at one size ({"from": "expressions"}). The ear positions draw a head with no cheeks to run across: its width is placed by hand on the head's outline ({"hand": ends}).
_r3: Rule R3: no record names the Sad, Angry or Pout panels, the Both drooped ears, or the expression sheet's Sleepy face assembly, whose label pairs the face with drooped ears (DECISIONS.md 22; the sleepy preset is judged against the Sleepy expressions instead); faces.py refuses one, and a test fails if one exists. The dog's sheets draw no Angry. A mouth the sheet draws with its ends below its middle is 'downturned': it gets no corners, so no face is ever held to it, and its presets' mouths are judged by eye. They are the expression sheet's Curious and Sleepy (a short 人 under the nose) and Shy (a small ∩), and the master sheet's Curious and Sleepy, whose ends lie within a pixel of the line's lowest point as a 人's do, where Content's smile turns its ends up 2.5 px above its lowest point.
_gates: A preset is held to a panel's eyes when the panel draws an eye state the preset uses, and to its mouth's corners when it draws a mouth state the preset uses (states as L450-468 name them), each with its mark's shape; other anchors are reported, never held. The held anchors and shapes gate only on the preset's primary panel; on a turned panel a held pair is held by its spacing instead of each anchor's place. Where the preset names two eye states, its still shows the one its primary draws, and is held to it: singing and blissful the happy crescents, sleepy the closed eyes, proud the crescents with the sparkle's stars beside the head. On a wink panel drawn.wink names the winking eye, which the sheets draw as the happy crescent. Aliases: the dog's squeeze and sparkle eyes are its happy crescents (docs/QUESTIONS.md Q2's default).
_assemblies: The expression sheet's face assembly examples (Happy, Surprised, Mischievous) share the expressions' labels but are smaller drawings of the same faces that disagree with them: laid on each other at their own scales and pinned at the nose, the Mischievous assembly's eyes lie 3.5 and 5.0 pt from the Mischievous expression's, the Surprised assembly's 2.7 and 2.1 pt from the Surprised expression's, the Happy assembly's 0.6 and 1.3 pt from the Happy expression's. No assembly gets a record: the expression and the master sheet's expression row already draw each of those faces larger.

neutral.note: Happy (default): the master sheet's Happy is the primary, less rolled than the expression sheet's (9.7 against 11.8 degrees) and on the sheet that ranks first. Idle is the motion sheet's Idle / breathing, not an expression panel, so it is compared by phase 4's Poses check. Both Happy panels draw an open mouth and neutral's is the smile: their eyes are held, their mouths reported.

happy.note: The master sheet's Happy, for the reasons neutral gives; the expression sheet's beside it.

excited.note: The master sheet's Excited (11.7 degrees of roll against the expression sheet's 12.1); the expression sheet's beside it. Its mouth's corners lie within 0.5 pt of Laughing's and its outline overlaps Laughing's at IoU 0.76: see laughing.

laughing.note: The master sheet's Laughing (11.9 degrees against the expression sheet's 20.0). The master sheet draws Laughing's mouth no wider than Excited's: the corners within 0.5 pt, the open part 1.25 times as large, less than Happy's and Excited's open mouths differ (1.27 times). No gate tells laugh from open there without failing happy against excited, so excited and laughing legitimately match on the master sheet; the open part's difference is reported, and judged by eye.

curious.note: The master sheet's Curious: both Curious panels tilt the head about 21 degrees and turn it toward the sheet's left (the eyes' middle 5.1 and 4.1 pt across from where the front puts it), so the sheet that ranks first decides. Turned: its open eyes are held by their shapes and spacing, and on the head. Its mouth, like the expression sheet's, is downturned (see _r3), judged by eye. Every panel that draws open eyes as far apart passes there (Happy, Surprised, Shy), so curious and shy legitimately match on what is held; their gaze, ears, blush and mouths are judged by eye.

surprised.note: The expression sheet's Surprised: the only level Surprised (2.8 degrees of roll against the master sheet's 13.1), the master sheet's beside it. The sheets draw the wide eye as the open eye with a ring of white round its iris (expressions.eyes.surprised-round): its dark mark, which the check compares, measures as the open eye's (areas within 1.16 times, IoU 0.78 to 0.91), so a surprised face passes the eyes neutral holds; the mouth (o) is what differs.

shy.note: The expression sheet's Shy, the only Shy panel. Its mouth is a small ∩, and shy's is a smile: its eyes are held, its mouth judged by eye. The head is turned toward the sheet's left (the eyes' middle 4.4 pt across from where the front puts it): its eyes are held by their shapes and spacing, and on the head. The far ear hangs across the right cheek, so its width is its sheet's median.

proud.note: The master sheet's Content is the primary: it draws proud's states (happy crescents and a smile) on a level head. The Proud panel raises the chin (its crescents 3.9 pt above the nose against Content's 6.8 and the turnaround's open eyes' 8.1), and a face preset keeps the front's head, so it is shown beside, with its stars for the sparkle (Q2). The still shows the sparkle: the happy crescents, held on Content, with the stars beside the head.

mischievous.note: The master sheet's Cheeky draws the wink with the cheeky mouth (the dog's left eye closed, the tongue out) on a nearly level head (6.6 degrees): the primary. Winking (the same wink with a smile) and the expression sheet's Mischievous, whose head is turned halfway to three-quarter and which winks the dog's right eye, are beside it. The face library winks the left eye, as Cheeky draws it. An open mouth passes Cheeky's mouth rows: the expression sheet's Mischievous draws its cheeky mouth open with the tongue in it, as Happy draws the open mouth, and only the deep-red share of the open part (Cheeky 0.14; the master sheet's open and laughing mouths 0.35 to 0.40; the expression sheet's Mischievous 0.27) tells Cheeky's tongue out from it, reported and judged by eye (docs/QUESTIONS.md Q27).

content.note: The master sheet's Content (both eyes closed in happy arcs, a small smile, level).

sleepy.note: The master sheet's Sleepy (lying, chin on its paws, eyes closed; 8.8 degrees against the expression sheet's 9.5), the expression sheet's beside it: sleepy's 'then closed' eyes are held, so its still shows the closed eyes. No level panel draws closed eyes, and both Sleepy panels turn the head (the eyes' middle 3.0 pt across from where the front puts it): the closed arcs are held by their shapes and spacing, and on the head. Both mouths are downturned (see _r3), judged by eye. Not the expression sheet's Sleepy face assembly, whose label pairs it with drooped ears (R3).

listening.specPanels: the ear positions Lifted, Forward and Perked
listening.note: Lifted slightly is the dog's lifted ears (Forward and Perked are the other species' names). It draws a head with no face, so no anchor is held: the record places the render beside it, on the head's top, for the eyes of the agent and the founder; the face is still held to its head.

tender.note: The master sheet's Content (L493). Tender's eyes are the sleepy half-lid, which Content does not draw: its smile is held, its eyes reported, and held on the head by the eye parts' own pixels, which a lid closing over the eye does not move.

singing.note: The master sheet's Laughing: its crescents are singing's happy eyes and are held, so its still shows the crescents, not the closed eyes; its open mouth is not singing's o and is reported. Happy (both sheets) and the expression sheet's Laughing are beside it.

blissful.note: The master sheet's Content (L495): its crescents (blissful's 'then happy') and its smile are held, so its still shows the crescents, not the closed eyes.

ticklish.note: The master sheet's Laughing holds ticklish's laughing mouth. Its eyes are the squeeze, the dog's own > < drawn as the kitty's and the bear's Excited draw theirs (docs/QUESTIONS.md Q2, the founder's choice of Oct 16, 2026; DECISIONS.md 200, 202, 206): no panel of the dog's sheets draws them, so they are judged by eye beside those two panels (qa/phase3/faces/eyes.png) and held on the face's head only, and this record lists no eye state for the check to hold (listed as squeeze, the aliases' Q2 default would hold them to Laughing's crescents, which they are not). Excited (both sheets) and the expression sheet's Laughing are beside it.

hungry.specPanels: none: drawn new from the Surprised and Happy panels, approved by the founder
hungry.note: A new drawing the founder approves (L497, R3); no panel.

huffy.specPanels: none: drawn new for Grumpy and approved by the founder
huffy.note: A new drawing the founder approves (L498, R3); never the sheets' Angry or Pout; no panel.

sly.note: The master sheet's Cheeky, as mischievous; Winking and the expression sheet's Mischievous beside it.

master.expression.happy._note: Head rolled about 10 degrees counter-clockwise. The open mouth's corners are the tips of the upper lip's curls.

master.expression.excited._note: Eyes closed in happy arcs. The two pink excitement marks at the upper left and the 3 x 5 px tip of Laughing's motion line at the right edge are left out.

master.expression.laughing._note: Eyes closed in happy arcs, the mouth open with the tongue. The three orange motion lines at the upper left are left out.

master.expression.curious._note: Head tilted about 21 degrees clockwise and turned a little toward the sheet's left; the tuft's top is nearly flat, so the head top (reported only) sits where its line is highest. The question mark is left out. The mouth's ends lie within a pixel of its lowest point: downturned, no corners.

headWidth.why: the front paws lie over both cheeks

master.expression.sleepy._note: Lying, chin on the paws, eyes closed in downward arcs; head rolled about 9 degrees clockwise. The mouth's ends lie within a pixel of its lowest point: downturned, no corners.

master.expression.surprised._note: Round eyes, a small o with its inside pink. The yellow surprise marks at the upper right are left out. The o's corners are its sides.

master.expression.winking._note: Winks the dog's left eye (the sheet's right) in a happy arc; a smile with the tongue's tip under it; level.

master.expression.cheeky._note: Winks the dog's left eye (the sheet's right), the tongue out under the upper lip, whose curls are the corners.

master.expression.content._note: Both eyes closed in happy arcs, a small smile whose ends turn up; level.

expressions.expression.happy._note: Head rolled about 12 degrees counter-clockwise. The open mouth's corners are the tips of the upper lip's curls.

expressions.expression.excited._note: The two red excitement marks at the upper left are left out.

expressions.expression.laughing._note: The three blue laugh lines at the upper left are left out. The raised paw sits under the mouth's right corner (the sheet's left), clear of it.

expressions.expression.curious._note: Head rolled about 21 degrees clockwise and turned a little toward the sheet's left. The question mark above the head is left out. The mouth is a short 人 under the nose: no corners.

headWidth.why: the front paws lie over both cheeks

expressions.expression.sleepy._note: Lying, chin on the paws, eyes closed in arcs; head rolled about 10 degrees clockwise. The three z marks are left out. The mouth is a short 人: no corners.

expressions.expression.surprised._note: The two yellow surprise marks at the upper left are left out. The o's corners are its sides.

headWidth.why: the far ear hangs across the right cheek and the head is turned a little toward the sheet's left: the cheeks' run measures 114 px against the expressions' 131 to 137

expressions.expression.shy._note: Paws held up under the chin, blush on the cheeks. The mouth is a small ∩: no corners.

expressions.expression.proud._note: Chin raised, eyes closed in happy arcs, a small smile with a tooth at its left. The yellow sparkles at the upper left and the two small marks at the right are left out.

expressions.expression.mischievous._note: Winks the dog's right eye (the sheet's left), tongue out; the head turned toward the sheet's right. The two red marks at the upper right are left out.

headWidth.why: a head with no face or cheeks: the head's outline below the lifted ears, level

expressions.ears.lifted-slightly._note: Head only, drawn without eyes, nose or mouth. The 2 px sliver of the One ear perked drawing's ear at its right edge is left out.
